text:
alex-ae: Heads-up — Nimbus Clinical wants to close Dedicated 24mo (committed) but with unusual cash flow: 50% upfront, 25% at month 6, 25% at month 12. They also want invoices split across two bill-to entities (US ops in USD, EU research in EUR) and the final payment to be Net60 due to internal approval cycles. Any objections?
sophie-dealdesk: Please confirm total ARR and amounts by currency + the legal entity names/Tax IDs. Any escrow or holdback request?
alex-ae: Total committed value = $1.2M ARR (100k/mo equivalent). Upfront = $600k USD to Nimbus Clinical USA, milestone1 = €150k to Nimbus Clinical EU (EUR equivalent agreed in PO), milestone2 = €150k, final true-up = $300k USD Net60 to US entity. They asked for a 5% deployment acceptance holdback on the EU milestone until on-prem validators sign-off.
omar-finance: FX and mixed currency is doable but increases AR work. We need agreed exchange rate clause and which currency is primary for reconciliation. 5% holdback ok if we treat as short-term retention. Who is covering bank/FX fees?
tanya-legal: Two points: (1) we need amendment listing both bill-to entities with VAT IDs, payment currency, and primary governing law; (2) holdback must include acceptance criteria + timeframe for release or auto-release clause. Also need liability allocation if one entity defaults.
kevin-se: From SE — on-prem validators will require a test harness and acceptance checklist. If funds are held in escrow pending acceptance, schedule might slip. Need to align acceptance gates to milestone dates.
rachel-csm: Customer insists on split because research budget runs in EUR. They provided two POs and a vendor questionnaire confirming tax status. POs: PO-US-8812, PO-EU-3345.
sophie-dealdesk: Deal Desk: conditional approval possible if Finance + Legal confirm GL mapping, currency clause, and holdback language. Also need underwriting sign-off and confirmation we can accept Net60 on last invoice (non-standard).
omar-finance: Net60 accepted conditionally. We require a short GL mapping CSV from the rep listing bill-to, PO, tax ID, currency, and desired GL codes. Also note: Net60 will increase DSO, requires manual AR aging rule. We'll charge FX fees to customer unless contract states otherwise.
tanya-legal: I'll draft a 2-paragraph SOW amendment. Key lines I'll add: "Invoices will be issued to the Bill-to entity and in the currency stated on the invoice. Customer bears any bank charges and currency conversion losses. A defined acceptance test for the EU milestone must be attached; retention (5%) will be released within 30 days of documented acceptance or automatically on day 90 if no acceptance notice provided." Thoughts?
alex-ae: That language looks good. I'll ask Nimbus to confirm they accept auto-release at day 90 if they don't return acceptance docs.
kevin-se: I'll prepare the acceptance checklist and test harness plan. ETA tomorrow.
rachel-csm: I uploaded the two POs and the EU VAT certificate to the deal record. Customer also asked for an invoice reference format: INV-NIM-{dealid}-{entitycode}-{seq}.ar.
invoice-bot: Invoice ticket created: INV-2041-810 assigned to AR. Reminder set for 7 days to confirm GL mapping.
sophie-dealdesk: Final items before approval: (1) GL mapping CSV, (2) signed amendment referencing Master Agreement, (3) underwriting credit OK for mixed currency split. If legal and finance sign, I'll mark Approved-conditional.
omar-finance: I'll approve after GL CSV. Send to ar@redwood.com and finance-ops for processing.
tanya-legal: Draft posted below (short): "Amendment: Payment schedule as stated; each Bill-to listed with Tax ID; retention & acceptance attached; currencies specified; Net60 applies only to invoices issued to Nimbus Clinical USA for final payment; non-payment by one Bill-to does not waive the other's obligations"
sophie-dealdesk: Looks good. Once GL CSV is in and underwriting confirms I'll update thread.
alex-ae: Sent GL mapping CSV to ar@redwood.com and pasted underwriting note: "soft credit ok, no sanctions, EU entity has limited credit but PO in place".
invoice-bot: Follow-up reminder scheduled in 72 hours if signature not recorded.
sophie-dealdesk: Received GL CSV and underwriting note. Conditional approval granted. Please attach amendment and route for signature. :white_check_mark:
note: No title field included per agents.md
